title: EU Tender Alerts input
description: Watch EU public tenders on TED. Pass the same monitorId on every scheduled run (or run a saved Task): each run returns only notices this watch has not delivered yet. Minimal call: {"cpvCodes": ["72000000"], "countries": ["FR"], "monitorId": "it-fr"}. Pricing: $0.002 per successful run and $0.003 per notice delivered (already delivered or filtered notices are free); set maxTotalChargeUsd on the run to cap spending.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Full-text search terms (any of them matches), e.g. 'cybersecurity', 'facility management'. Letters, digits, spaces and . , ' & / + - only. Leave empty to watch by CPV code or country alone.

keywordScope.title: Keyword scope
enumTitles: Full notice text (broad: also matches addresses, URLs and boilerplate)
keywordScope.description: Where keywords are searched. Full text finds more notices but many are false matches (for example 'cloud' in a document URL).

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary codes. 8 digits (72000000 = IT services, sub-codes included) or a shorter prefix (7226 = all codes starting 7226).

countries.title: Buyer countries
countries.description: Country of the contracting authority, as ISO codes: FR, DE, IT, ES, NL ... (2 or 3 letters). Empty = all countries publishing on TED.

noticeKinds.title: Notice kinds
noticeKinds.description: Which notices to deliver. tenders = new calls for competition; updates = corrigenda and re-published tenders (with the changed deadline/value when the watch knows the original); awards = contract award results with winners and values; planning = prior information notices.

minValue.title: Minimum value
minValue.description: Skip notices whose published estimated value (or award value) is below this amount, in the notice's currency (usually EUR). Notices without a published value are always kept. Skipped notices are free.

monitorId.title: Monitor ID (keeps this watch's memory)
monitorId.description: Any name for this watch, e.g. 'it-tenders-fr-de'. Use the same ID on every scheduled run so only new notices are returned. Saved Tasks get their own memory automatically.

lookbackDays.title: First-run look-back (days)
lookbackDays.description: How far back the first run of a watch searches. Later runs continue from where the previous run stopped.

firstRun.title: First run
enumTitles: Deliver the notices of the look-back window
Record them silently (start clean, nothing charged per notice)
firstRun.description: What the first run of a new watch does with the notices it finds.

expertQuery.title: Expert query (advanced)
expertQuery.description: Optional TED expert-search expression, AND-ed with the filters above, e.g. procedure-type=open. Do not filter on publication-date (the Actor manages the date window). Syntax: TED expert search help.

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: 3-letter code for titles when TED provides a translation (eng, fra, deu, ita, spa ...). Falls back to English, then the notice's official language.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Add the procedure description (in its original language).

emitSummary.title: Add a run summary record
emitSummary.description: Adds one free record per run (recordType 'summary': window, matching notices, delivered, already delivered). A scheduled run then always returns a result, also when nothing is new. Turn off when every dataset row must be a notice.

maxDescriptionChars.title: Max description length
maxDescriptionChars.description: Descriptions are cut at this many characters (descriptionTruncated says when).

maxNoticesPerRun.title: Max notices per run
maxNoticesPerRun.description: Upper bound on notices delivered (and charged) in one run. Remaining notices are delivered by the next run.

maxPagesPerRun.title: Max search pages per run
maxPagesPerRun.description: Each page reads up to 250 matching notices from TED. Bounds run time for very broad watches.

stateStoreName.title: Memory store name (advanced)
stateStoreName.description: Explicit key-value store name for the watch memory, e.g. to share one memory between Tasks on purpose. Normally leave empty and use monitorId.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries on timeouts and temporary TED errors (with backoff).
